gen.orderNote: Taught order follows the numbered list.

steps.label: A bill is a proposal for a new law
steps.quote: 1. A bill is a proposal for a new law or a change to an existing law.

steps.label: assigned to a committee
steps.quote: 2. Once a bill is introduced, it is assigned to a committee whose members will research, discuss, and make changes to the bill.

steps.label: put before that chamber to be voted on
steps.quote: 3. The bill is then put before that chamber to be voted on.

steps.label: passes one body of Congress
steps.quote: 4. If the bill passes one body of Congress, it goes to the other body to go through a similar process of research, discussion, changes, and voting.

steps.label: vote to accept a bill
steps.quote: 5. Once both bodies vote to accept a bill, they must work out any differences between the two versions.

steps.label: president then considers the bill
steps.quote: 6. The president then considers the bill.
